name: MoSJE / NBCFDC Micro Finance Scheme
nodal_agency: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment / NBCFDC
target_beneficiaries: Rural micro-entrepreneurs, backward classes, marginalized artisans & farmers
description: Concessional small-ticket credit window for village micro-enterprises with simplified documentation and 3-month grace moratorium.
key_benefits: Low concessional interest rate of 6.5% p.a.
3-month moratorium on principal repayment to stabilize cash flow
Fast-track processing through State Channelizing Agencies (SCAs)

name: MoSJE / NBCFDC / NSFDC Term Loan Scheme
nodal_agency: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment / NSFDC / NBCFDC
target_beneficiaries: Rural & semi-urban micro/small enterprises needing machinery & equipment
description: Medium-to-large capital asset creation loan for rural agro-processing, dairy units, workshop machinery, and retail infrastructure.
key_benefits: Concessional interest rate of 8.0% p.a. for up to ₹50 Lakhs project cost
Extended 7-year repayment window with 6-month initial moratorium
Up to 90% loan component covering capital assets and working capital margin
Direct bank linkage with MoSJE interest subsidy alignment

name: PMEGP (Prime Minister Employment Generation Programme)
target_beneficiaries: Rural youth, women, SC/ST, OBC, and minority entrepreneurs
description: Credit-linked subsidy program offering 25% to 35% margin money government subsidy for rural micro-enterprises.
key_benefits: Up to 35% government subsidy in rural areas for special categories
Bank term loan for remaining capital requirements

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (Kishore Category)
description: Collateral-free business credit for service units, shopkeepers, and micro-manufacturers.
key_benefits: No collateral or third-party guarantee required
MUDRA debit card provided for working capital drawdown
